newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - OCT 4.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - OCT 4.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Members of the German Parliament visiting Budapest said that Hungary will certainly be among the first countries who could join the NATO.
- At least 15 percent of decrees made by the state administration organisations infringe the law, said the government commissioner for state administrative reforms.
- The planned strike of Romanian customs officers endanger the border traffic.
- The ratio of Hungary's planned energy price increase cannot be lower than 25 percent and cannot be above 40 percent, according to economic research insitute GKI.
- The chief abbey of Pannonhalma and the Konrad Adenauer Foundation jointly organise a conference with the title "The state, the church and the culture."
